name: Chrono Pendulum "Principal's Message"
descriptionTemplate: At the start of the battle, gain the {Weakness} Orison and {Computation} Orison along with their Adv. {Orisons} to place on selected cards.
lore:
The words of the founder of Mythag linger in your ears.

May the Silver Key light your path, Mythag's Keeper.
